scope: Independent read-only product architecture investigation; prior source/native reviewer, not implementation author. No candidate, native execution, SDK change or canonical acceptance.
conclusion: Installed core-module/1 supports multiple ordinary theorem declarations and complete declaration-name audit coverage. An all-native canonical Read33 representation is a supported-language alternative to blocked native-to-semantic imports, subject to a separately reviewed design preserving all original names/propositions and actual full-root verification. No new SDK is intrinsically required merely to express multiple native theorems. No evidence here establishes that the 33 resulting proofs will pass.
